description: This file defines the MainFlutterWindow class, which is a subclass of NSWindow, used to set up the main application window for a Flutter macOS application. It overrides awakeFromNib to initialize the Flutter view controller and configure the window.

classes.name: MainFlutterWindow
classes.description: A subclass of NSWindow responsible for creating and configuring the main application window for Flutter on macOS.

methods.name: awakeFromNib
methods.description: Overrides the awakeFromNib method to set up the Flutter view controller and configure the window when the interface loads.
